The '''Boiling Sea Music Academy''' was a [[Music/Legends|music]] academy on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Champhra Biahin]], the planet Drall's [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] to [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], sent a recording of the anthem ''[[Flowers of Drall]]'', sung by young students at the academy, to the chairperson of the [[Dearic Garden Club]] as a token of gratitude for the club's help in procuring a sample of the rare [[Twin-Scented Natterbloom]].
